required GitHub Actions pass on final PR head

stop_conditions: Any required behavior cannot be derived from the Blueprint or approved Owner decisions.
A change would create parallel identity, policy, routing, scheduling or dispatch authority.
A required cloud resource, paid service, production change, credential or external approval appears.
A test or security gate fails for a pre-existing blocking reason that cannot be isolated.
